name: g1
goal: Train a blind 29-DoF Unitree G1 policy in mjlab/MuJoCo Warp and transfer to CPU MuJoCo over flat, sloped, rough and stepped terrain. Stand 2 s, then follow a public forward velocity command of 0.5–0.65 m/s for 18 s.
score: 100 * walking survival fraction * exp(-speed MAE/commanded speed) * clipped forward-progress fraction. Success requires full 20 s survival, speed MAE<0.25 m/s, forward travel>65% of commanded walking distance, lateral drift<2 m. Standing still scores zero.
feedback: Video frames and noisy measurements only; no deployment scores, contacts, parameters, seeds or true state. Diagnosis is a short observation/change/prediction, not private reasoning.
policy_abi: numeric fixed MLP NPZ (8 MiB maximum)
limitations: Simulation transfer only, not hardware. Fixed 98→512→256→128→29 ELU actor and public PD wrapper. Coding-agent feedback is noisy joint angles, public commands and images.
